blurb: Joy of Dance Centre offers private and semi-private dance lessons in styles such as Ballet, Contemporary, Hip Hop, Jazz, Ballroom, and Latin. They also provide wedding dance lessons, party packages for adults and kids, and special workshops including beginner pointe workshops. The studio is located in Toronto and serves a wide range of dance interests and skill levels.
